name: Redeemed by Ragathiel
body:
Drawbacks
Redeemed by Ragathiel
Source Divine Anthology pg. 18
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Ragathiel
You were born into a family, nation, or other group that tried to impress evil ideals upon you, but you were inspired by Ragathiel to live a moral life despite their influence. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Sense Motive checks to see through an evil creature’s Bluff attempts.
